code: import os import json import time import asyncio import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from playwright.async_api import async_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError # ================= 配置区域 ================= # 目标URL TARGET_URL = "https://www.chinabond.com.cn/xwgg/ggtz/xwgg_gsgg/gsgg_zytz_ath/" # 爬取时间范围 (用户指定) START_DATE = "2025-12-01" END_DATE = "2025-12-31" # 输出目录 OUTPUT_DIR = r"d:\llm_mcp_genpy\pygen\output" # 并发控制 CONCURRENCY = 3 # 详情页并发抓取数量 # ================= 工具函数 ================= def ensure_dir(path): if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗HTML内容： 1. 修复图片和链接的相对路径为绝对路径 2. 移除无用的脚本和样式标签 """ if not html_content: return "" try: soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, 'html.parser') # 移除 script 和 style for script in soup(["script", "style"]): script.decompose() # 修复图片链接 for img in soup.find_all('img'): if img.get('src'): # 处理可能的懒加载属性 src = img.get('src') if not src.startswith(('http', 'data:')): img['src'] = urljoin(base_url, src) # 修复超链接 for a in soup.find_all('a'): if a.get('href'): href = a.get('href') if not href.startswith(('http', 'javascript', '#', 'mailto')): a['href'] = urljoin(base_url, href) return str(soup) except Exception as e: print(f"[Warn] 内容清洗出错: {e}") return html_content def parse_date(date_str): """解析多种格式的日期字符串为 YYYY-MM-DD""" if not date_str: return None # 清理空白字符 date_str = date_str.strip() # 尝试匹配 YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY.MM.DD patterns = [ r'(\d{4})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})[\/\-\.](\d{1,2})', r'(\d{4})年(\d{1,2})月(\d{1,2})日' ] for pattern in patterns: match = re.search(pattern, date_str) if match: y, m, d = match.groups() return f"{y}-{m.zfill(2)}-{d.zfill(2)}" return None # ================= 爬虫逻辑 ================= class ChinaBondCrawler: def __init__(self): self.results = [] self.seen_urls = set() ensure_dir(OUTPUT_DIR) async def crawl_list_page(self, page): """抓取列表页数据，处理翻页""" print(f"[*] 开始抓取列表: {TARGET_URL}") await page.goto(TARGET_URL, wait_until="networkidle") has_next_page = True page_num = 1 while has_next_page: print(f"--- 正在处理第 {page_num} 页 ---") # 等待列表加载 try: await page.wait_for_selector('.rightListContent', timeout=10000) except: print("[!] 未找到列表内容，可能已到达末尾或页面加载失败") break # 获取所有列表项 items = await page.locator('.rightListContent').all() if not items: print("[!] 当前页无数据") break current_page_valid_count = 0 stop_crawling = False for item in items: try: # 提取日期 date_el = item.locator('.rightListTime') if await date_el.count() == 0: continue date_text = await date_el.inner_text() pub_date = parse_date(date_text) if not pub_date: continue # 日期过滤逻辑 if pub_date > END_DATE: continue # 日期太新，跳过 if pub_date < START_DATE: # 假设列表是按时间倒序的，如果遇到早于开始日期的，说明后面的更旧 # 为了保险，我们不立即停止，而是标记一下，如果连续多条都旧，再停止 # 这里简单处理：只要遇到旧数据，就标记可能需要停止 stop_crawling = True # 但当前页可能还有符合的数据（如果不是严格排序），所以只跳过当前条目 # 严格模式：break # 宽松模式：continue # 考虑到新闻网站通常严格倒序： print(f"[Info] 发现旧数据 ({pub_date})，早于开始时间，停止翻页。") has_next_page = False break # 提取标题和链接 link_el = item.locator('.rightListImport.unlock a') if await link_el.count() == 0: continue title = await link_el.get_attribute('title') if not title: title = await link_el.inner_text() href = await link_el.get_attribute('href') full_url = urljoin(page.url, href) if full_url in self.seen_urls: continue self.seen_urls.add(full_url) article_info = { "title": title.strip(), "date": pub_date, "sourceUrl": full_url, "source": "中国债券信息网", "status": "pending" # 待抓取详情 } self.results.append(article_info) current_page_valid_count += 1 print(f"[+] 捕获: {pub_date} | {title[:30]}...") except Exception as e: print(f"[!] 解析列表项出错: {e}") continue if not has_next_page: break # 翻页逻辑 # 检查下一页按钮 next_btn = page.locator('.pageBox .pageNext') # 检查是否可点击 (是否存在，是否可见，是否被禁用) if await next_btn.count() > 0 and await next_btn.is_visible(): # 有些网站最后一页下一页按钮还在，但点击没反应或href为空 # 检查是否有 disabled 类或者 href # 根据提供的HTML，下一页是 ，没有href，靠JS点击 try: # 记录当前URL或页面状态，用于判断是否翻页成功 # 这里简单等待网络空闲 await next_btn.click() await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') await asyncio.sleep(1) # 额外等待DOM渲染 page_num += 1 except Exception as e: print(f"[!] 翻页失败: {e}") has_next_page = False else: print("[*] 没有下一页了") has_next_page = False async def crawl_detail_page(self, context, article): """抓取详情页内容""" page = await context.new_page() try: # print(f"正在抓取详情: {article['title']}") await page.goto(article['sourceUrl'], wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000) # 尝试定位正文内容 # 常见的新闻正文容器 class content_selectors = [ '.main-content', '.article-content', '.TRS_Editor', '#zoom', '.xl_main', '.content' ] content_html = "" for selector in content_selectors: if await page.locator(selector).count() > 0: content_html = await page.locator(selector).inner_html() break # 如果没找到特定容器，尝试提取 body if not content_html: content_html = await page.locator('body').inner_html() # 清洗内容 article['content'] = clean_html_content(content_html, article['sourceUrl']) # 提取摘要 (前200字) soup = BeautifulSoup(content_html, 'html.parser') text_content = soup.get_text(strip=True) article['summary'] = text_content[:200] + "..." if len(text_content) > 200 else text_content article['status'] = "success" except Exception as e: print(f"[!] 抓取详情失败 {article['sourceUrl']}: {e}") article['status'] = "failed" article['content'] = "" finally: await page.close() async def run(self): async with async_playwright() as p: # 启动浏览器，配置反爬参数 browser = await p.chromium.launch( headless=True, # 设置为 False 可视化观察 args=["--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled", "--no-sandbox"] ) context = await browser.new_context( viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080}, user_agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" ) # 1. 抓取列表 page = await context.new_page() await self.crawl_list_page(page) await page.close() print(f"[*] 列表抓取完成，共找到 {len(self.results)} 条符合日期的数据。开始抓取详情...") # 2. 并发抓取详情 # 将任务分批处理 pending_articles = [a for a in self.results if a['status'] == 'pending'] # 使用信号量控制并发 sem = asyncio.Semaphore(CONCURRENCY) async def safe_crawl(article): async with sem: await self.crawl_detail_page(context, article) tasks = [safe_crawl(a) for a in pending_articles] if tasks: await asyncio.gather(*tasks) await browser.close() # 3. 保存结果 self.save_results() def save_results(self): # 过滤掉失败的或者不完整的 valid_articles = [a for a in self.results if a.get('status') == 'success'] # 移除临时字段 for a in valid_articles: a.pop('status', None) timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") filename = f"chinabond_news_{timestamp}.json" output_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, filename) data = { "total": len(valid_articles), "crawlTime": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "dateRange": { "start": START_DATE, "end": END_DATE }, "articles": valid_articles } with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) print(f"\n[OK] 任务完成！结果已保存至: {output_path}") print(f" 共抓取 {len(valid_articles)} 条数据") # ================= 主程序入口 ================= def main(): print("=== 中国债券信息网爬虫启动 ===") print(f"目标: {TARGET_URL}") print(f"日期范围: {START_DATE} 至 {END_DATE}") crawler = ChinaBondCrawler() asyncio.run(crawler.run()) if __name__ == "__main__": main()
